description: This file defines the Emails class for managing email-related activities in a CRM system, including saving emails, attaching files, relating emails to contacts and users, and exporting email data. It includes methods for email module operations, relationship handling, and utility functions for email data retrieval and attachment management.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: Main class managing email activities within the CRM, including saving, attaching files, retrieving related contacts, export functionality, and relationship management. Extends CRMEntity to integrate with core CRM entity functionalities.

methods.name: Emails
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the Emails class, setting up logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles the saving process of email records, including relationship updates with contacts, users, attachments, and related entities.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Inserts file attachments associated with the email record, including PDFs and uploaded files, and manages related database entries.

methods.name: saveForwardAttachments
methods.description: Saves forwarded email attachments by fetching email parts and storing files as attachments.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to an email record, optionally providing actions for selection or bulk mailing.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Determines the sorting order for email listings based on request/session or default.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Fetches the field by which email records should be sorted.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Retrieves associated users for an email activity, including options for bulk mailing and user selection.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs SQL query for exporting email data with permission controls.

methods.name: set_emails_contact_invitee_relationship
methods.description: Links an email record with a contact in the database.

methods.name: set_emails_se_invitee_relationship
methods.description: Links an email record with a sales entity in the database.

methods.name: set_emails_user_invitee_relationship
methods.description: Links an email record with a user in the database.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationships between email and other entities.

methods.name: getNonAdminAccessControlQuery
methods.description: Generates access control SQL snippets for non-admin users.
